title: 第26章 一年后第27章 新战铠被封印的神器
content_zh:
“轰——”一声巨响。
“神君你就这嘛？战争之斧！开天斧意！无尽砍杀！”邪帝的手掌之中突然绽放出一团耀眼的光芒，紧接着，一把巨大而威猛的双刃斧凭空浮现出来。这把斧头通体闪烁着神秘的金黑双色光芒，其上铭刻着古老而玄奥的符文，仿佛蕴含着无尽的力量和奥秘。
随着邪帝一声怒喝，他猛然挥动手中的双刃斧，瞬间释放出了一种无与伦比的帝王级斧意。这股斧意犹如汹涌澎湃的洪流一般，以排山倒海之势向着神君疾驰而去。
只见那把斧头散发着一种令人心悸的气息，仿佛它能够劈开天地之间的一切阻碍。这种气息让人联想到宇宙初开时的混沌状态，充满了原始的力量和创造力。在这股气息的笼罩下，周围的空间都似乎变得扭曲起来，仿佛随时都会被撕裂开来。
“切，天穹圣剑！圣明剑意！极光审判！”神君一脸淡漠地看着前方，眼神之中充满了轻蔑之色。他微微抬手，只见一柄三尺长的白色长剑出现在他的手中，剑身闪烁着耀眼的光芒。
这柄白剑仿佛拥有无尽的力量，当它被神君握住时，整个空间都为之颤抖起来。一道璀璨的白色剑光从剑尖射出，如同闪电一般，瞬间淹没了邪帝所释放出来的斧意。
那强大的威压在这道白色剑光面前显得如此脆弱不堪，眨眼间便消散得无影无踪。而神君却依旧站在原地，手中的白剑散发出令人心悸的气息，仿佛随时都能斩破虚空。
“这是战争之神和极光战神的本命帝器呐，真没想到他们还得到了他俩的力量，不过帝器还未苏醒，只有神级武器的威势。”
“这后期到巅峰怎么那么难啊wok。”邪帝再来一斧，破开了神君的剑意。
神君与邪帝已经将功法修炼到后期一年了，是的，他俩在时空次元神庙已经一年了，一个月就迈入功法后期，卡在后期十来月了。
“吾当初就说过，后期到巅峰可不会那么容易。”
“都一年了，不知道他们怎么样啊，好想他们啊。”邪帝感叹道。
“这一年我们也更强了啊，时空与次元的运用已经很熟练了。”神君看着手中散发出次元气息的天穹圣剑。
这一年来，时空与次元属性好似附加能量一般被邪帝和神君运用在暗与光的力量上以及附着在武器上。
“到底怎样才能入巅峰呢？”邪帝把玩着中指上的地狱魔戒。
邪帝扭动地狱魔戒，“地狱之爪，帝君临尘！”一道暗光照耀在邪帝身上，暗龙虚影环绕暗光而下。
邪帝，以神之姿态降临于世，毁灭天地
“暗渊魔瞳！神君，让我万圣进化。”
“cARd光明！”邪帝穿过cARd，“邪帝万圣形态。”
邪帝运转《时空凐灭诀》，金色修长的地狱之爪染上时空之力。

“时空爪击！”两道爪印轰然而出。邪帝望向神君。
神君手上抛着一个正方体，“想这样打？那就来吧。”
“光能聚炮！”正方体被抛向空中，自动解体组合，变成了光能聚炮！
“帝君临尘！”
金色光柱照耀着神君，光龙虚影从地上冒出吞噬神君。
神君，以神之姿态降临于世，救赎天地
“极致金瞳！”
“cARd黑暗！”
“神君魔神化！”神君穿过cARd，散发着混沌气息的光能聚炮，明耀圣翼夹杂着黑暗，神君宛如圣战神堕入深渊一般。
content_en:
"Boom -" there was a loud noise.
"Is this what you are doing, Lord God? Ax of war! Sky-opening axe! Endless slashing!" A dazzling light suddenly burst out from the evil emperor's palm, and then, a huge and powerful double-edged ax emerged out of thin air. This ax shone with mysterious gold and black light, and was engraved with ancient and mysterious runes, which seemed to contain endless power and mystery.
As the Evil Emperor roared angrily, he suddenly swung the double-edged ax in his hand, instantly releasing an unparalleled emperor-level axe. This ax intent was like a surging torrent, rushing towards the Divine Lord with overwhelming force.
I saw that the ax exuded a heart-stopping aura, as if it could split all obstacles between heaven and earth. This breath is reminiscent of the chaotic state at the beginning of the universe, full of primitive power and creativity. Under the shroud of this aura, the surrounding space seemed to become distorted, as if it would be torn apart at any time.
"Tch, Holy Sword of Heaven! Holy Sword Intent! Aurora Judgment!" The Divine Lord looked ahead with an indifferent expression, his eyes full of contempt. He raised his hand slightly and saw a three-foot-long white sword appearing in his hand, the sword body shining with dazzling light.
This white sword seemed to have endless power. When it was held by the Lord God, the entire space trembled. A bright white sword light shot out from the tip of the sword, like lightning, instantly drowning out the ax intent released by the Evil Emperor.
The powerful pressure seemed so fragile in front of this white sword light, and it dissipated without a trace in the blink of an eye. But the Divine Lord still stood there, the white sword in his hand exuding a heart-stopping aura, as if he could cut through the void at any time.
"This is the natal imperial weapon of the God of War and the Aurora God of War. I didn't expect that they would get their power. However, the imperial weapon has not yet awakened and only has the power of a god-level weapon."
"Why is it so difficult to reach the peak in the later stage? Wow." The Evil Emperor struck again with his axe, breaking through the Divine Lord's sword intention.
The Divine Lord and the Evil Emperor have been practicing the technique to the late stage for a year. Yes, they have been in the Space-Time Dimension Temple for a year. They have entered the late stage of the technique in one month and have been stuck in the late stage for more than ten months.
"I said at the beginning that reaching the peak in the later stage will not be that easy."
"It's been a year. I don't know how they are. I miss them so much." The Evil Emperor sighed.
"We have also become stronger this year. We have become very skilled in the use of time, space and dimensions." Shenjun looked at the Holy Sword of Heaven exuding dimensional aura in his hand.
Over the past year, the attributes of time, space and dimensions have been used by the Evil Emperor and the Divine Lord like additional energy in the power of darkness and light and attached to weapons.
"How can I reach the peak?" The Evil Emperor played with the Hell Ring on his middle finger.
The evil emperor twisted the hell ring, "Hell's claw, the emperor comes to the dust!" A dark light shone on the evil emperor, and the shadow of the dark dragon surrounded the dark light.
The evil emperor came to the world as a god and destroyed the world
"Dark Abyss Demonic Eyes! Divine Lord, let me evolve into a Saint."
"cARd light!" The evil emperor passed through cARd, "The evil emperor's holy form."
The evil emperor activated the "Time and Space Destruction Technique", and the golden and slender claws of hell were dyed with the power of time and space.
"Time and Space Claw Attack!" Two claw marks shot out. The Evil Emperor looked at the Divine Lord.
The Lord Shen threw a cube in his hand, "Want to fight like this? Then come on."
"Light energy cannon!" The cube was thrown into the air, automatically disintegrated and combined, and turned into a light energy cannon!
"Emperor Linchen!"
The golden light beam illuminated the Divine Lord, and the phantom of the light dragon emerged from the ground and swallowed the Divine Lord.
The Divine King comes to the world as a god to redeem the world.
"The Ultimate Golden Eyes!"
"cARd dark!"
"The Divine Lord is transformed into a demon!" The Divine Lord passed through the cARd, exuding a chaotic aura of light energy cannons, and the bright holy wings were mixed with darkness. The Divine Lord fell into the abyss like a holy war god.。
